Name: Biker Jacket Sebastian Portrait and Sprite
Author: TheMainFlamingoose
Description:
Sebastian's all black attire / hoodie seemed too "angst" for my taste, so I decided to give him a new style. This one seems a little more grown up and rebellious rather than emo. It seemed fitting since he actually rides a motorcycle. Mod includes both the portrait and sprite. Enjoy ! 











To apply sprite: Stardew Valley/Content/Characters. Drop the sprite xnb file in this folder.
To apply portrait: Stardew Valley/Content/Portraits. Drop the portrait xnb in this folder.
